message.content: Helios provides several recommendations for handling flying machines in "Horizon Forbidden West." According to his advice, using a bow equipped with elemental arrows can effectively stun the flying machines, allowing players to take them down more easily. Additionally, Helios suggests utilizing the focus mechanic to track the movements of the flying machines, which helps in dodging their attacks. These strategies seem to be based on practical experience and are aimed at enhancing gameplay engagement and survival.
